- ⚠ disputed: Wrong port for the staging service  [main]  (id 0f0f0f0f0f0f, unread) [⚠ 1 drift-flagged citation(s)]
    ↳ the staging service binds 127.0.0.1:9000 in the demo env and a spare port everywhere else; never curl 9000 from a test, and never bind it either — the demo container owns it and a bind fails closed, not shared.
<!--kb-recall/1 kb=main id=0f0f0f0f0f0f-->
- demo-repo fixture builds are IO-bound, not CPU-bound  [kb]  (id 111111111111, unread)
    ↳ the demo-repo build tree and its fixture corpus share one disk, so a parallel build starves the test run; tuned by pruning a background index job, switching the disk scheduler and lowering swap use.
<!--kb-recall/1 kb=kb id=111111111111-->
- ✗ didn't work: demo-repo CI workflow facts  [kb]  (id 222222222222, unread)
    ↳ sign-off needs a signed commit; the lint step runs before tests so a lint failure masks test failures; the main workflow only triggers on PRs to main, so stacked PRs run signature checks only.
<!--kb-recall/1 kb=kb id=222222222222-->
- Demo service file-descriptor ceiling  [main]  (id 333333333333, unread)
    ↳ a long soak run exhausted the demo service's file descriptors and every request failed with too many open files; the fix is raising the descriptor limit and restarting the service.
